feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is claimed for it. Evidence so far: iteration 4 (y = 0.07 m, wheel_track 0.11) scored 364.1 with oval 16/20 finishes, but s-bend 0/20 with line-loss 1.4 and slalom 0/20 with line-loss 1.95 per run. Iteration 5 (wheel_track 0.10 m, same controller) scored 362.5, with oval 17/20 at max_error 0.036 m, s-bend line-loss 1.3 and slalom 1.95. Narrowing 0.11 to 0.10 m moved s-bend line-loss only slightly, and slalom not at all. The controller did not need compensating beyond the unchanged iteration 4/5 settings, so the Integrator has no new controller-side evidence to report for this geometry. Decision rules for the next race: (a) If s-bend line-loss is 1.0 or below with max_error under 0.06 m and the oval holds at 16/20 or better, keep wheel_track 0.09 m. (b) If s-bend line-loss stays above 1.0 with max_error near 0.06 m and the oval holds, narrowing is the only geometry lever left and 0.09 m is the floor, so do not go narrower. (c) If slalom stays near 1.9 line-loss at 0.09 m, the remaining gap is likely the controller's response on sharp bends, not body geometry, so the next iteration should move to controller weights or kp rather than further geometry. (d) If the oval drops below about 14/20 or steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.35 with low max_error, return wheel_track to 0.10 m, since that oscillation points to the controller and the oval is hurt by the narrower track.
requested_changes: Keep wheel_track at 0.09 m only if s-bend line-loss falls to 1.0 or below with max_error under 0.06 m and the oval holds at 16/20 or better. Evidence: iteration 5 narrowed 0.11 to 0.10 m and moved s-bend line-loss only from 1.4 to 1.3 and the oval rose to 17/20, so the narrowing is safe but weak.

If the oval falls below about 14/20 or steering_oscillation rises above 0.35 with low max_error at 0.09 m, return wheel_track to 0.10 m. Evidence: iteration 4 oval oscillation was 0.28 and iteration 5 was 0.26 at 0.10 m, so a rise would be a sign of the narrower track.

If slalom line-loss stays near 1.9 and s-bend stays above 1.0 at 0.09 m, do not narrow further and keep y = 0.07 m, span ±0.03 m, sensor_size 0.012 m, mass 0.7 kg and wheel_radius 0.03 m. Evidence: span (iteration 2) and footprint (iteration 3) changes both hurt, and iteration 4 showed y = 0.07 m helped the oval, so change weights or kp next, not geometry.
